result.decision_rationale:
A failed unsubscribe can leave the witness receiving results after its only reconciliation. Final cleanup then misses those units. The caller can also report a positively identified unit as unknown, and the abandonment test still supplies its own final cleanup sequence.

## Continuation for Claude

Preserve the mandatory stop at review 2 of 2 and report these findings to the owner. C3 requires a current C2 handoff. If the owner authorizes further C2 work, retain witness observations through final cleanup, resolve ownership by unit identity, and exercise the production finalizer through ProbeSlot. The focused evidence should show what happens to a result delivered after a failed unsubscribe, including its request, settlement and effect on admission. Keep any requalification within the external harness, the existing candidate-3 package, the short lifecycle session and the shared recovery allowance.

findings.actual: ReleaseNow removes each held action before invoking it. WitnessCaller consumes its reconciliation even when unsubscribe throws. The still-subscribed witness can append further identities, but GhaeleLifetimeProbe.Release only drains and settles the disposable inventory. A newly observed unit held solely by the witness never enters that inventory.
findings.blocking_rationale: The original unsubscribe error blocks the next probe, but an identified owned unit can remain alive without a destruction request or a per-unit cleanup result.
findings.expected: Final release accounts for every result the witness received before the slot ended and retains the unsubscribe error.
findings.requested_correction: Keep the observations of a possibly subscribed witness available to final cleanup. Reconcile later arrivals before final settlement, using the existing per-unit request guard.
findings.requested_evidence: Fail early unsubscribe while leaving delivery active. Deliver an additional correlated unit and an unknown unit before slot termination. Show one request and a terminal result or named residual for the correlated unit, a named failure for the unknown, the original unsubscribe error, foreign survival and refused admission.
findings.title: Final cleanup misses results received after a failed unsubscribe
findings.trigger: Early unsubscribe throws before detaching the witness, then another result arrives while the same probe is still running.

findings.actual: Observed.Unknown excludes only Known controls. When the same reference appears in Unattributed and Owned, Release adopts and requests it, then RecordUncertain reports that its ownership is unknown and it was left in place.
findings.blocking_rationale: A conclusively attributed and successfully settled unit can produce a false cleanup failure and prevent the next probe from starting.
findings.expected: Positive attribution resolves that unit's earlier uncertainty. A unit with only a fixture-teardown registration remains unknown.
findings.requested_correction: Compute residual unknowns by reference after accounting for positively correlated units and explicit foreign controls. Preserve the independent fixture-teardown rule.
findings.requested_evidence: Supply an unattributed observation followed by a positively correlated observation for the same reference. Verify one request, successful settlement, an empty residual-unknown set and clean admission. Retain the registered-but-unattributed refusal case.
findings.title: Positive attribution does not clear an earlier unknown observation
findings.trigger: One witness receives an unattributed result and a later positively matched result for the same unit before release.

findings.actual: LateUnitProbe.Release constructs its own ReleaseRemaining and Settle action array. GhaeleLifetimeProbe.Release constructs a separate array. Omitting final settlement from the production array would leave the domain abandonment assertion green. Its source check only matches the ordinary SettleOwned call.
findings.blocking_rationale: The mission requires behavioral evidence through the caller that determines isolation on abandonment. The native session covers ordinary completion of that caller.
findings.expected: The controlled abandonment case executes the production sequence that requests remaining units, reads settlement and returns cleanup to ProbeSlot.
findings.requested_correction: Exercise the production finalizer from the slot regression, either directly with controlled native operations or through one final release sequence shared by the production probe and the fixture.
findings.requested_evidence: Abandon before ordinary settlement. Show that the actual final row and ProbeSlot carry the same unresolved unit, the original timeout survives, independent cleanup runs and the next Begin is refused. A terminal read that becomes readable on the next call would also distinguish the repaired single-snapshot behavior.
findings.title: The abandonment regression still substitutes the final cleanup sequence
findings.trigger: The regression is used to qualify final settlement when the enclosing probe is abandoned.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Terminal returns unresolved for an undestroyed unit absent from State.Units. The controlled pending-registration case recorded one request, a named unresolved unit and refusal of the next probe.

RecordUncertain now retains the unknown identity even when the fixture owns its teardown. The registered and unregistered controls exercise both outcomes. R2-F2 concerns a unit with subsequent positive attribution.

Subscription release and reconciliation run as independent held actions. The focused case preserves the unsubscribe exception and settles the extra unit observed before that exception. R2-F1 concerns later delivery.

Final settlement no longer invokes the global destroyer tick. It reads each requested unit and records a pending or unreadable result by identity. Removing the forced drain eliminates its exception path.
LateResultReconciliation.Settle takes one terminal snapshot and passes it to both the evidence row and RecordUnsettled. The focused fixture verifies agreement for a consistently unresolved unit.

The lifecycle check requires the flag sampled before fallback. Foreign survival is read after settlement, and the late and real-spawn native rows explicitly record the foreign control unrequested at that boundary.

The regression now uses the production WitnessCaller and a participating foreign control. Its own final action array still determines the abandonment result, leaving the production finalizer outside the failure test.
The pre-C2 statement is dated through C1 and all expenditure rows are in one Markdown table. The separate round-2 handoff discrepancy is recorded as R2-F3.
